B3.code: tmux.ts `lookupPane(server, paneId): {status:'present', pid} | {status:'absent'} | {status:'failed', detail}` -- `absent` only for a nonzero exit whose stderr matches the exported `PANE_GONE_STDERR` (can't find pane | no server running | error connecting ... (No such file or directory)) or a successful listing missing the row; any other nonzero exit or an unparseable pid is `failed` with argv+stderr in detail. runtime-tmux.ts `verifyPaneProcess` maps `failed` to `{verified:false, reason:'listing-failed', detail}`; `probe` THROWS `Error('cannot verify pane %N: <detail>')` on it (never alive, never gone; pane-gone -> gone, every other unverified -> not-recorded-process); `stop` order is graceful ask -> `if (refuseKill) return` -> verify -> verified: kill-pane (PANE_GONE_STDERR tolerated) / listing-failed: `throw new ProcessStopFailed(locator, detail)` / other unverified: return, logging only when it decided itself. Callers: `probeLocator` (probeTree / controllerAlive / resurrectDeadTree) rethrows -> resync `probeActiveRoots` Promise.all rejects -> `runResync` rejects -> index.ts logs `resync failed:` and reschedules (a probe effect is emitted only by resync, never by a durable reducer, so it is never DurableFatalFailure); `closeTreeLocked` probes INSIDE the try around its stop, so a throw is `anyFailed` -> tree left `lingering`, locator untouched, `StopFailed` (502); `retireUnconfirmedRoot` catches, logs, re-arms the registration deadline for the same generation; `WorkerBootWatchdog.probeAlive` catches, logs `liveness probe did not complete; re-arming`, returns true (no launchFailures increment; the registration deadline still bounds it). Worker stops (closeTreeLocked's worker loop, retireWorkerLocator via markWorkerDeadLocked/retireUnconfirmedBoot/launchWorker) take ProcessStopFailed -> StopFailed through the pre-existing failed-kill handling: claim and locator untouched.
